question: Compare the 2025 completed revenue per buying customer of EMEA and APAC. If EMEA's is more than 10% higher than APAC's, list EMEA's top 3 customers by 2025 completed revenue; otherwise, list APAC's top 3. Give each customer's ID, name and revenue.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH region_rev AS (SELECT r.region_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS total_rev, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buying_customers FROM regions AS r JOIN customers AS c ON c.region_id = r.region_id JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND r.region_name IN ('EMEA', 'APAC') GROUP BY r.region_name), metrics AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN region_name = 'EMEA' THEN total_rev / NULLIF(buying_customers, 0) END) AS emea_rev_per_customer, MAX(CASE WHEN region_name = 'APAC' THEN total_rev / NULLIF(buying_customers, 0) END) AS apac_rev_per_customer FROM region_rev) SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM customers AS c JOIN regions AS r ON c.region_id = r.region_id JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND r.region_name = CASE WHEN (SELECT emea_rev_per_customer FROM metrics) > 1.1 * (SELECT apac_rev_per_customer FROM metrics) THEN 'EMEA' ELSE 'APAC' END GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3
